summary: Virus scanner availability is read once at startup and never refreshed
evidence: lib.rs:15 Arc::from(current_virus_scanner()); clamav.rs:33-46 from_install_dir checks is_file() once; commands.rs:97-100 clamav_status returns the cached flag
failure_scenario: clamscan.exe installed after launch: status stays unavailable until restart. clamscan.exe removed after launch: status says available but scan fails with probe instead of engineMissing.
